scope: per-SHA build checkouts on network runners (SshBuildRunner.checkout_base)
why: Unbounded per-SHA dirs filled the builder disk (23G, ENOSPC fail-blind, 2026-09-08). No eviction and no pre-trigger disk read-back existed anywhere.

keep.pinned_note: A SHA is pinned only by a converged proof WITH test counts. A count-less converged report pins nothing.

evict.rule: Evict checkouts older than ttl_days except kept and pinned. Eviction is a bounded explicit action (lists paths, removes, reports freed bytes) — never silent, never a bare rm -rf without read-back.

preflight.rule: Before materializing a checkout, read back runner disk space. Below min_free_bytes the trigger reports blocked_disk_full (explicit unknown) instead of failing mid-fetch with ENOSPC.

residual_unknowns: Enforcement owner undecided: runner-side cron vs pre-trigger gate in SshBuildRunner vs CLI surface. This file is policy; the enforcer gets its own slice with proof.
